title: Project Renewal
description: Venture the twisted roads of the Renewal Springs...
body:
Project renewal is a mod lost to the endless passage of time, Reborn again you could say...

This is a story and atmospheric mod that plans to create a fun playing experience for the players. Have fun!

This mod is still in beta so expect bugs and unfinished content.

# **Features:**
- Structures
![picture of renewal springs structure](https://i.imgur.com/73gcA52.png)

- Biomes
  ![void biome](https://i.imgur.com/cbflQ50.png)

- Mobs
  ![new modded mobs](https://i.imgur.com/pX6J6CJ.png)


## Progression:
1. Find crystal biome
2. mine crystal blocks
3. create crystal of renewal
4. Craft beacon (check spawning book)
5. place beacon inside a renewal spring crystal (structure listed above)
   
   ![8 crystal shards, 1 diamond](https://i.imgur.com/6j3Gszu.png)
   
_more story and progression planned in the future_
